messages:
Liang: FYI - EpochBridge requested a 32k instruct variant with int4 quant + seq-kv long-context. They want Dedicated deployment and cost caps. Opening intake for triage and timeline.
Maya: @Liang can you paste the eval set + expected failure modes? need specifics for hallucination, truncation, and tokenization edge cases.
Liang: quick config I put in the intake form:
```
model: epochbridge-32k-instruct
context: 32768
quant: int4
kv_cache: seqkv
deployment: dedicated
slo: p50<180ms, p95<500ms
batch_target: 8
```
Zach: Those p95 targets are aggressive for int4 at 32k. What's our allowed fallback ladder? int8? shorter ctx?
Liang: Customer ops require a cost cap. Proposal: try int4 first; if p95 > 700ms fallback to int8 variant; if still constrained, route to 16k variant or degrade to async batch. Open to other ideas.
Eva: Rollout checklist from infra side: smoke tests, canary at 5%, gradual ramp to 25% then 100%, rollback hooks, and monitoring alerts (latency, OOMs, error-rate). I'll own the canary. :+1:
Alex: QA note: need an eval suite covering long-doc summarization, instruction-following (multi-step), code-block handling, and memory tests for KV reuse. I'll build a fuzz harness and OOM regression tests. Add a short prompt set for prompt-sensitivity.
Maya: Also schedule a quant sweep: int4 PTQ vs qlora/QLoRA-ish approaches. Command I used before: `/run-quant-sweep epochbridge-32k --modes ptq,qlora --batch 32 --metric perplexity,acc`
Zach: For perf bench, we should record: cold start, cached prefix reuse, KV cache hit/miss ratios, and peak GPU memory. Add some microbench scripts for seq lengths at 2k/8k/32k.
Liang: I'll add those to the RFC. Customer asked for an initial bring-up by next Wednesday. Is that realistic?
Zach: We can get a coarse perf sweep by Tue (int4 vs int8, basic workloads). Full regression/eval and safe canary will likely need until end of week.
Eva: Marking timeline: canary Friday, ramp next Monday if no regressions.
Maya: I'll draft the quant experiment matrix and upload CSV to the RFC doc. Also include tokenizer edgecases for long code blocks.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `deploy/epochbridge-32k-instruct -> dedicated/gpupool-5` (ticket RB-9876).
Liang: Priority = P2 (paid Dedicated). Assigning tasks: @Maya quant sweep, @Alex eval harness, @Eva canary ops, @Zach perf bench. Ping me when you have blockers. :rocket:
Maya: will update RFC at https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/epochbridge-32k (draft) and add experiment matrix.
Alex: I'll post eval artifacts in the thread when ready and tag everyone.
Liang: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for intake notes and quick syncs.
